doc-001: Council approves a six-month Market Street cycle lane trial (7–4) from March, weighing the loss of 40 parking spaces raised by local businesses against growing commuter cycling.
doc-002: Work-related stress is causing weeks of poor sleep. A small change to caffeine intake has helped somewhat, and the person intends to raise their workload with their manager.
doc-003: In an observational five-year cohort of 1,200 adults, at least 30 minutes of daily walking was associated with a 6 mmHg lower systolic blood pressure, with the largest effect in over-60s; causality cannot be inferred.
